events.info: Chart a course through the night sky to Disney On Ice -- where every story starts with a wish! Create new memories with Raya from Raya and the Last Dragon and Asha from Wish, and become enchanted by Tiana, Rapunzel, and The Disney Princesses. events.info: Bingo Loco The Wildest Bingo Party in Laredo! Looking for the most outrageous bingo party in the USA or the top-rated bingo show in Canada? Welcome to Bingo Loco, the interactive live event that has taken North America by storm. We have turned traditional bingo on its head this is a full blown party rave with DJs, dance offs, lip sync battles, confetti showers, and wild prizes you will not believe. Highlights Global Hit: After selling out in over 200 cities worldwide, Bingo Loco lands in Fayetteville for one of its biggest nights yet. Insane Energy: High-octane stage show with rave rounds, dance battles, DJs, and confetti explosions. Crazy Prizes: From Vegas trips to air fryers, inflatable flamingos, and more. Epic Throwbacks: 80s, 90s, and 00s hits, from ABBA to Britney Spears. Comedian MCs: Hosts bringing nonstop laughs and energy.
events.pleaseNote: General Info Duration: Approx. 2.5 hours Location: Sames Auto Arena Age Limit: 21+ (ID required) Disclaimer: May contain adult content Accessibility: Contact venue for options Seating: Seating: First come, first served. Get your squad together and arrive early to claim the best seats in the house. Each table seats 6 or 7, so be friendly and make room for others! Details may vary per venue. Some venues have reserved seating with their ticketing, so please check your ticket for specifics. For table reservations, we recommend contacting the venue directly.

events.info: Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Live Color Bash takes the action to a whole new level, transforming the arena into a full-throttle collision of color. Vibrant paint-splattered trucks, bursts of color, and electrifying lighting turn every smash, and crash, into a vivid spectacle the whole family can see, feel, and remember. When the mischievous Skelesaurus drains all the color from Monster Truck Island, it's up to the crew of Rhinomite, Mega Wrex, Tiger Shark, and Bigfoot to win it back -- one massive stunt at a time, joined by a mysterious new ally! Every wheelie, jump, donut and freestyle run brings the color roaring back, building to a full-arena burst of light, sound, and pure Monster Truck energy. It's the show you love, reimagined like you've never seen it.
